sentences.text: Shri Sourabh Bhushan Shrivastava - Advocate for the a  Ms. Ranjana Agnihotri - Dy. GA for the respondent/Sta  ORDER
Learned counsel appearing for the State submits that intimation of this case has already been served upon the guardian of the victim.

This is the first bail application under Section 483 of the BNSS, 2023 on behalf of applicant - Pramod S/o Shri Narayan Bediaya who has been arrested by Police Station Raisen, District Raisen (MP) in connection with Crime No.564/2023 registered under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(n)A,
376(3), 506 of IPC and 5L/6 of POCSO Act.
The applicant is in custody since 09.11.2025.
The prosecution case in brief is that on 10.11.2023, the mother of the victim lodged a missing person report at Police Station, Raisen alleging that her daughter is missing since 09.11.2023.
Missing person report was registered, thereafter police started investigation and recovered the victim and handed over the custody to her parents.

In the statement given to the NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:70466 2 MCRC-58213-2025 police the victim stated that the present applicant made physical relations with the victim for several times and consequently, offence was registered and present applicant was arrested.
After investigation charge sheet has been filed.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case only because of the reason he provided shelter to the victim.

He further submits that victim has given statement under Section 164 of Cr.P.C. before competent Magistrate and during her examination she has not levelled any allegation against the present applicant, no case is made out and the present applicant is in custody since 09.11.2025.
Investigation is over and charge sheet has been filed, he prays for enlarging the applicant on bail.

sentences.text: Learned Dy. Government Advocate appearing on behalf of the respondent/State opposes the bail application on the ground that upon the statement of the victim recorded in the investigation of missing person report the offence was registered against the present applicant and in the statement recorded under Section 161 the victim has specifically alleged that the present applicant made physical relation against her will.
She further submits that the victim is a minor girl and prays for dismissal of the application.

Considering the facts that victim has not levelled any allegation in the statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C., investigation is over, charge sheet has been filed, without commenting on the merits of the case, I deem it propert to enlarge the present applicant on bail.
Accordingly, the application is allowed.

The applicant is directed to be NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:70466 3 MCRC-58213-2025 released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
It is directed that the applicant shall abide by the conditions as enumerated under Section 480(3) of the BNSS.
(VINAY SARAF)
